full_judgment: 4. Thereafter, the case was transmitted to the Court of Special Tribunal Judge, Dhaka, for trial, who took cognizance of the offence and the same was registered as Special Case No. 97 of 1985. The case was further transferred to the Court of Special Tribunal for prevention of smuggling, Dhaka for trial. At the commencement of trial, the learned Tribunal Judge framed charge against the convict-appellant (in absentia) under section 156(8) of the Customs Act 1969 and section 3(1) of the Export Import Control Act, 1950 and sections 8 of the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1947 and sections 16 and 25(B) of the Special Powers Act. The accused absconded after obtaining bail and charge was framed in her absence.
